scripts.test:local: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test:safe && pnpm --filter @workspace/geit-website run test:platform && pnpm --filter @workspace/geit-website run test:reports && pnpm --filter @workspace/geit-website run test:auth-ui && pnpm --filter @workspace/geit-website run check:localization
